routes.title: Walks through Cartagena
routes.intro: Choose a tour. We'll guide you stop by stop.
routes.calc: Distance is the straight line between stops × 1.25; time at 4 km/h plus stops. It is an estimate.
routes.lineNote: The line joins the stops in order; it is not the exact street route.
badges.title: Discover Cartagena
badges.intro: Earn badges as you explore. Your progress is saved only in this browser.
about.title: Sources and method
about.method: This project separates documented facts, interpretation and tradition, and labels each entry with its certainty level. No dates, people or coordinates are invented: anything unverified is flagged.
about.coords: Locations: positions are approximate and being verified on the ground. Each entry states its accuracy.
about.tourism: Visitor information: hours and fares come from official sites, with the date they were checked. They may change.
about.credits: Maps: © OpenStreetMap contributors, © CARTO, imagery © Esri. Built with Leaflet.
ui.error: The data couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
ui.offline: Offline: the base map may not load, but the place guides are still available.
tts.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support voice narration.
